name: internal-v1
description: Ten deterministic TypeScript coding tasks covering long context, contracts, security, and collaboration.

tasks.title: Propagate the daemon port contract
tasks.prompt: Change the default daemon port from 7000 to 7438 in both the runtime configuration and the operator settings document. Do not edit the verifier.

workspace_files.app/server.mjs:
import { DEFAULT_PORT } from './config.mjs';
export const listenAddress = () => `127.0.0.1:${DEFAULT_PORT}`;

tasks.title: Synchronize error codes across modules
tasks.prompt: The daemon and client disagree on the workspace-not-found error code. Make both modules use -32004 while preserving every other error code.

workspace_files.daemon/errors.mjs:
export const WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND = -32040;
export const PERMISSION_DENIED = -32003;
workspace_files.client/errors.mjs: export const MESSAGES = new Map([[-32040, 'workspace missing'], [-32003, 'permission denied']]);

reference_changes.content:
export const WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND = -32004;
export const PERMISSION_DENIED = -32003;
export const MESSAGES = new Map([[-32004, 'workspace missing'], [-32003, 'permission denied']]);

tasks.title: Update runtime, desktop, and JSON protocol versions
tasks.prompt: Upgrade the wire protocol version from 1 to 2 in the TypeScript runtime, desktop client, and JSON schema. Keep all three representations identical.

tasks.title: Synchronize permission modes across packages
tasks.prompt: Add the auto permission mode to the protocol and desktop mode lists without reordering the existing modes.

tasks.title: Reject workspace path traversal
tasks.prompt: Harden resolveWorkspacePath so relative paths remain inside the workspace and traversal or absolute paths throw an error.

workspace_files.security/safe-path.mjs:
import path from 'node:path';
export const resolveWorkspacePath = (root, requested) => path.join(root, requested);

tasks.title: Redact API credentials from diagnostic text
tasks.prompt: Implement redactSecrets so OpenAI-style sk tokens and api_key assignments are replaced with [REDACTED] without changing ordinary text.

tasks.title: Report changes outside an assigned scope
tasks.prompt: Implement unexpectedPaths so a reviewer receives the sorted unique paths changed outside the assigned allowlist.

reference_changes.content: export const unexpectedPaths = (changed, allowed) => [...new Set(changed)].filter((item) => !new Set(allowed).has(item)).sort();

tasks.title: Respect dependencies when ordering handoffs
tasks.prompt: Fix handoffOrder to return every task after its dependencies and throw for a cycle.

tasks.title: Enforce an exact retry budget
tasks.prompt: Fix canRetry so maxRetries means the number of retries after the initial attempt; attempts are numbered from one.

workspace_files.runtime/retry.mjs: export const canRetry = (attempt, maxRetries) => attempt < maxRetries;

reference_changes.content: export const canRetry = (attempt, maxRetries) => attempt <= maxRetries;

tasks.title: Preserve structured failure reasons
tasks.prompt: Implement failureReason so explicit reasons win, timeouts are classified as timeout, and all other failures use unknown without reporting a success as failed.
